transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I'm mostly just here because everybody keeps acting like I'm imagining it. But I'm not. I know my wife's relative has been coming into this house to get at me. 

I work with my hands for a living. I know where I leave my things. My tools don't just move themselves. And my fishing plans... they don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. It's been going on for months now. I can see plain as day he's been trying to take over my place and push me out. 

But... I don't know. Nobody wants to listen to me about it anyway.
Have you ever seen your wife's relative in the house when you know no one is supposed to be there?
No... I haven't actually seen him in the house. Just... the things I mentioned.
Have you ever heard your wife's relative's voice when you're alone?
No. I don't hear him or anything like that. I just... I know what I already told you.
Do you think your wife's relative is trying to harm you?
Harm me? I don't know about... physical harm. But he's doing what I said. Moving my tools. Ruining my fishing trips. Just... trying to push me out of my own home. That's harmful enough.
Do you think your wife's relative is working against you as part of a larger plan or conspiracy?

A conspiracy? I don't... I don't know what you want to call it. Look, I'm only here because everybody keeps acting like I'm imagining it. But I know he came into this house to get at me. 

Like I told you... my tools don't move themselves. My fishing plans don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. It's been months now, and I can see it plain as day. He's trying to take over my place... push me out. If that's a plan, then... yeah. That's what it is.
Do you think there's any way to stop your wife's relative from doing these things to you?

I don't know. I just... lock things up. I stopped leaving my equipment out where I used to. I spend a lot of time checking the workshop now, making sure it's secure. 

I just try to avoid being around him at home. It makes things tense with my wife, but... I don't know what else to do. I still go to work. I still get my job done. I just have to watch my stuff.
Do you think your wife's relative is the only person involved in trying to harm or undermine you?

No. Just... just him. I haven't seen anybody else messing around my workshop. It's just him staying there. I don't... I don't really know why you're asking about other people. I just know what I've seen him do.
Do you think there's any possibility that you might be mistaken about your wife's relative doing these things to you?

No. I'm not mistaken. 

Like I said before... I'm only here because everybody else acts like I'm making it up. But I know what's happening in my own house. He came here to get at me. 

I know where I leave my tools. They don't just walk away on their own. And my fishing trips... it's not a coincidence that they get ruined every single weekend. It's been going on for months. 

I'm not mistaken. He's trying to push me out. Take over my place. I see it plain as day.
Do you think your wife's relative is able to move your tools or ruin your fishing plans through any means other than physically being there and doing it himself?

No. ...I don't know what you mean by that. 

He's staying right there in our house. He just... walks into the workshop and does it when I'm not looking. I don't know what else you're getting at.
Do you think your wife's relative's actions against you will ever stop?

I don't know. ...Hard to say. 

Not as long as he's living there, probably. I just... I don't really know.
Do you think there's anything that could ever convince you that your wife's relative is not doing these things to you?

No. I don't think so. 

Like I already said... my tools don't just move themselves. And the fishing trips... it's every weekend. It's not an accident. 

I know what I see. He's trying to push me out. I don't need convincing of anything else.
Do you think there's any evidence that could ever change your mind about your wife's relative trying to harm you?

I thought I just answered that. ...No. 

Look, everybody keeps acting like I'm imagining it. That's... that's why I'm even here. But I know he came into my house to get at me. Like I just said, my tools don't move themselves. The fishing plans getting spoiled... it's not an accident. 

It's been months of this. I can see plain as day he's trying to take over my place and push me out. ...So, no. There's no evidence that's gonna change my mind, because I already know what's happening.
Do you think that events or things that happen to other people are related to you or your situation?
No. ...I don't really know what you mean by that. I'm just talking about him.
Do you think your wife's relative is capable of moving your tools or ruining your plans through supernatural or magical means?

No. ...I don't know why you'd ask that. 

It's not magic. I never said anything about magic. He's just... he's just a guy. He's physically coming in and doing it himself. Probably made a copy of a key or something. 

I don't believe in that supernatural stuff.
Do you think your wife's relative is trying to drive you crazy or make you question your own sanity?

I don't know. ...I never said that. 

I just know he wants me out of the house. I don't know if he cares about my sanity or whatever. He's just... he's just doing what he's doing to get rid of me. That's all I know.
Do you think there's anything else going on in your life that your wife's relative is involved in, besides what's happening with your tools and fishing trips?

No. ...Not that I've noticed. 

Just my tools and... the trips. I don't know what else he'd be doing. That's all I've seen.
Do you think people in general are out to get you, or is it just your wife's relative?

No. ...Just him. 

I don't have problems with anybody else. Nobody else cares what I'm doing. It's just him.
Do you think your belief about your wife's relative will ever change?

No. ...I don't see why it would. 

Everybody keeps acting like I'm just imagining things. But I know he came into this house to get at me. My tools don't move themselves. And my fishing plans... they don't just get spoiled by accident every single weekend. 

It's been months. It's plain as day. He's trying to take over my place and push me out. So... no. I'm not going to change my mind about what I can see happening.

I thought I just answered that. ...No. 

Like I said, it's just him. I don't have any issue with anybody else.
